help.connections.close: x reviews closing the selected live connection; closed records are read only. Close all affects every live connection, including those outside the filter or paused view.
help.rules.search: Alt+C toggles case sensitivity · Alt+W whole-word matching · Alt+R regular expressions.
help.search.input: While searching, Enter / Esc leaves the input and keeps the filter; Tab / Shift+Tab moves to another control.
help.settings.keys: Tab / Shift+Tab visits setting controls; Enter / Space applies an option or opens its editor. Esc / ← / h returns to navigation. Focus a language or routing-mode option before confirming it.
help.overview.keys: ↑↓ / j/k browses cards; Enter / Space focuses an available control inside the card. Read-only cards have no enter action. Tab / Shift+Tab visits controls; Enter / Space activates them. Esc / ← / h returns to navigation.
help.core.proxies: While browsing content: x stops the core.
help.core.overview: While browsing content: s starts · x stops the core.
help.navigation.keys: While browsing: ? opens Help · q quits. Page shortcuts are suspended while typing or using a menu or dialog.
help.controls: In Help: Tab / Shift+Tab changes buttons; Enter activates. ↑↓ / j/k scrolls; PgUp / PgDn turns pages; Space goes to the next page; Home / End jumps to the ends. Esc / ? closes Help; q quits the app.
help.messages.controls: In notifications: Tab selects an action; Enter / Space activates it. x / Delete / Backspace dismisses the selected notice without canceling its task. Esc / q goes back or closes the panel.
